facts.fact: Smart News Liberia reports the arrest of an unnamed person accused of creating a manipulated video of Vice President Koung at Brussels Airport, after which the Executive Protection Service director warned such material could be prosecuted under the Cybercrime Act; the document gives no arrest date, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: Unnamed person accused over manipulated video of the Vice President

note: Opinion piece on the law's reach; the arrest is the same event as in documents 6 and 7, and the document gives no date for it.
